title: Sharp Lp–L2 moment comparison for centred log-concave random variables, with equality cases
creator: Anonymous
admissibleClass: Nondegenerate mean-zero real random variables with log-concave density; bounded and half-line supports allowed.
claimCeiling: Current-source normal and optimised macOS replay passed; frozen-extraction and Linux outcomes recorded separately in release checks
Exactly two families at transition modulo scaling and reflection
All admissible laws are extremal at p=2
No priority claim for Eitan real-exponent reduction or crossing method
Qualitative fixed-p stability only; no explicit rate or uniformity through pStar or 2

claims.statement: For 1<p<pStar, inf ||X||p/||X||2=Gamma(p+1)^(1/p)/sqrt(2), with equality exactly for positive multiples of L.
At p=pStar the endpoint constants coincide; equality consists exactly of multiples of L and signed multiples of E-1, two families modulo scaling/reflection.
For pStar<p<2, inf ||X||p/||X||2=F(p)^(1/p), with equality exactly for signed positive multiples of E-1.
At p=2 the ratio is 1 for every admissible law.
For p>2, sup ||X||p/||X||2=F(p)^(1/p), with equality exactly for signed positive multiples of E-1.
Equality-sensitive reduction for real 1<a<b to scaled Z_s; follows established Eitan reduction and crossing-method lineage.
claims.locator: paper.tex: thm:R2, thm:R1 and lemmas A-G

claims.statement: For real p>=7 and 0<s<=1/2, N(s)^(p/2)F(p)-M(s,p)>0 by explicit K(p)>0.
H=G_0-G_h>0 on [1,1.682457208], H<0 on [1.682457209,39/20], H'<-0.016 between the two exact decimal endpoints.
limitations: Refined rounded historical root display is not an exact bracket

claims.statement: With eta=1/20, B1: G>G_h on [0,9/20]x[1,pStarHi-eta]; B2: G>min(G_0,G_h) on [1/20,9/20]x[pStarLo-eta,pStarHi+eta]; B3: G>G_0 on [1/20,1/2]x[pStarLo+eta,39/20]; B4: G<G_0 on [1/20,1/2]x[41/20,7]. Here pStarLo=1.682457208 and pStarHi=1.682457209 exactly.

For mean-zero variance-one log-concave laws mu, each fixed p>1 with p!=2 and each finite q>=1 admits a finite nondecreasing modulus omega_pq(t)->0 as t->0, such that min over nu in A_p of [TV(mu,nu)+W_q(mu,nu)] <= omega_pq(Delta_p(mu)).

definitions.A: Law((E-Ep)/sqrt(2)) for 1<p<pStar; all three oriented variance-one laws at pStar; Law(E-1) and Law(1-E) for pStar<p<2 or p>2

claims.uniformity: One modulus on each nonempty compact subset of (1,pStar), (pStar,2) or (2,infinity).
limitations: No uniform modulus through pStar or 2 with exact exponent-dependent equality sets
At pStar the target contains three oriented laws but two families modulo reflection
Standard compactness method, not claimed novel
